sections.subtitle: Share the operating details.
intro: Full Truckload transport gives one consignment the planned carrying capacity of a dedicated vehicle. It is commonly used when shipment volume, weight, handling needs or dispatch timing makes consolidation impractical.

Vidhi Transport coordinates the vehicle, pickup, route and delivery plan with the consignor and consignee. Final vehicle placement depends on cargo details, route conditions and operational availability.

intro: These answers explain the usual planning approach. Share the exact cargo and route for a shipment-specific response.

faqs.a: Full Truckload, or FTL, uses a dedicated vehicle for an accepted consignment instead of combining it with other customers’ freight.

faqs.q: When should a business choose FTL instead of Part Load?
faqs.a: FTL is usually more practical for larger loads, dedicated schedules, special handling requirements or consignments that use most of a vehicle’s capacity.

faqs.q: Which details are needed for an FTL quotation?
faqs.a: Share pickup and delivery locations, cargo description, packaging, approximate weight, dimensions, preferred vehicle and dispatch date.

faqs.q: Does Vidhi Transport provide FTL between Gujarat and Maharashtra?
faqs.a: Vidhi Transport coordinates accepted FTL movements across its Gujarat and Maharashtra industrial network, subject to route and vehicle availability.
